list_child.name: list_donations
list_child.desc: This tool returns every donation currently logged in the thrift store's intake system. It is useful for getting a full view of what has come in and where each item stands.

get_child.name: get_donation
get_child.desc: This tool fetches a single donation record using its unique identifier. Use it when you already know which donation you need details on.

list_parent.name: list_donors
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every donor who has given items to the thrift store. It provides a complete roster of the donor community.

get_parent.name: get_donor
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves the record for one donor given its id. It returns the donor's name and any notes on file.

delete_child.name: delete_donation
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently removes a donation record from the system, and the removal cannot be undone. It should be used only when an item was logged in error or has been discarded.

set_enum.name: set_donation_state
set_enum.desc: This tool moves a donation between received, sorted, priced, and shelved states. It is the primary way to track an item's progress through intake processing.

set_bool.name: flag_damaged
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a donation as damaged and unsuitable for the sales floor as-is. It is typically used during initial sorting when an item's condition is assessed.

set_ref.name: reassign_donor
set_ref.desc: This tool reattributes a donation from one donor to another. Use it when an item was logged under the wrong donor's name.

send.name: message_donor
send.desc: This tool sends a message to a donor regarding one of their donations. It is the standard way to follow up about drop-off logistics or thank a donor directly.
